title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Birch is a startup building banking apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Oldmoor office.

Our stack: kotlin, swift, go. You will build offline-first features, review code with the team and ship features end to end.

Regular hack days. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
